examples.ko: 가격을 몰래 올린 회사에 과징금이 부과됐어요.
examples.en: A penalty fine was imposed on the company that secretly raised prices.

examples.ko: 과징금 수십억 원을 내야 한대요.
examples.en: I heard they have to pay a penalty of several billion won.

examples.ko: 과징금이 너무 적어서 효과가 없다는 의견도 있어요.
examples.en: Some say the fine is too small to be effective.

examples.ko: 그 기업은 과징금에 불복해서 소송을 냈어요.
examples.en: The company refused to accept the fine and filed a lawsuit.

examples.ko: 개인정보를 유출한 업체가 과징금을 내게 됐어요.
examples.en: The company that leaked personal information has to pay a penalty fine.

examples.ko: 과징금 액수가 해마다 늘고 있어요.
examples.en: The amount of penalty fines is increasing every year.

explain: 뉴스에서 '과징금 부과'처럼 자주 나오고, 주로 정부 기관이 기업에 물리는 돈이에요. 형사 처벌인 '벌금'과는 달라요. 교통 위반은 보통 '범칙금'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The Fair Trade Commission imposed a penalty surcharge on the company.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기관이 돈을 물릴 때 쓰는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing for an authority imposing the charge.

phrases.en: That company decided to pay the penalty surcharge.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물게 된 쪽에서 돈을 낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the side that has to pay.

phrases.en: I saw the news about the penalty surcharge being imposed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스 제목이나 기사에서 명사처럼 짧게 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A short noun phrase typical of news headlines and articles.

explain_en: It appears in news as '과징금 부과', and it is money a government agency imposes, mainly on companies. It differs from '벌금', which is a criminal penalty. Traffic violations are usually called '범칙금'.

examples.ko: 휴대폰을 보며 운전하다가 범칙금을 냈어요.
examples.en: I paid a fine for driving while looking at my phone.

examples.ko: 이 도로에서 속도위반 범칙금이 얼마예요?
examples.en: How much is the speeding fine on this road?

examples.ko: 범칙금 고지서가 집으로 왔어요.
examples.en: The fine notice came to my house.

examples.ko: 안전벨트를 안 매면 범칙금이 나와요.
examples.en: You get a fine if you don't wear your seat belt.

examples.ko: 범칙금은 기한 안에 내야 해요.
examples.en: You must pay the fine within the deadline.

examples.ko: 오토바이로 신호를 어겨서 범칙금을 물었어요.
examples.en: I ran a light on my motorcycle and had to pay a fine.

explain: 주로 교통법규를 어겼을 때 내는 돈이에요. '범칙금을 내다/물다/부과받다'로 써요. 비슷한 '과태료', '벌금'이 있지만 제도가 서로 달라서 같은 말은 아니에요.

phrases.en: Can I pay the fine in cash?
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 기본적으로 쓰는 말이에요. 돈을 낸다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic expression, meaning to pay the fine.

phrases.en: I ran a red light and had to pay a fine.
phrases.nuance_ko: '내다'보다 잘못 때문에 어쩔 수 없이 낸다는 느낌이 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Feels more like paying unwillingly because of a mistake, compared with 내다.
phrases.en_equiv: to be made to pay a fine

phrases.en: If you speed, you get a fine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 규칙을 어기면 범칙금이 생긴다는 뜻으로 가볍게 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A casual way to say a fine will be issued if you break a rule.

explain_en: It is mainly the money you pay for breaking traffic rules, used as '범칙금을 내다/물다/부과받다'. There are similar words, '과태료' and '벌금', but they belong to different systems, so they are not the same thing.

examples.ko: 이 가구는 완성품으로 배송돼요.
examples.en: This furniture is delivered fully assembled.

examples.ko: 조립 키트보다 완성품이 값이 더 비싸요.
examples.en: The finished product costs more than the assembly kit.

examples.ko: 공장에서 완성품만 골라서 검사해요.
examples.en: At the factory they pick out and inspect only the finished goods.

examples.ko: 아직 완성품이 나오지 않아서 기다리는 중이에요.
examples.en: The finished product hasn't come out yet, so I'm waiting.

examples.ko: 완성품을 보니 설계도보다 훨씬 멋졌어요.
examples.en: Seeing the finished product, it looked much better than the blueprint.

examples.ko: 완성품은 한 달 뒤에 받을 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can receive the finished product in a month.

explain: 부품이나 재료 상태가 아니라 다 만들어져서 바로 쓸 수 있는 물건을 말해요. 반대 느낌의 말로는 '반제품'이나 '조립 제품'이 있어요. 장난감, 가구, 프라모델 같은 물건을 살 때 자주 구별해요.

phrases.en: Assembly was hard, so I bought it already finished.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조립 없이 바로 쓸 수 있는 상태로 산다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means buying it in a ready-to-use state with no assembly.
phrases.en_equiv: to buy it as a finished product

phrases.en: If you order, you receive the finished product in three days.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in delivery or ordering situations.

phrases.en: A semi-finished product has to be assembled at the end.
phrases.nuance_ko: 완성품과 구별해서 아직 덜 만들어진 물건을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Contrasted with 완성품, it refers to a product not yet completely made.

explain_en: It refers to a thing that is completely made and ready to use, not in parts or materials. Contrasting words include '반제품' (semi-finished goods) and assemble-it-yourself products. The distinction often matters when buying toys, furniture or model kits.

examples.ko: 부모님께 집을 증여받을 때는 세금을 내야 해요.
examples.en: When you receive a house as a gift from your parents, you have to pay tax.

examples.ko: 증여 계약서를 쓰기 전에 변호사와 상담했어요.
examples.en: I consulted a lawyer before writing the gift contract.

examples.ko: 자녀에게 미리 증여를 하면 세금이 줄어드나요?
examples.en: Does the tax go down if you give to your children in advance?

examples.ko: 증여와 상속은 어떻게 달라요?
examples.en: How are gifting and inheritance different?

examples.ko: 할머니가 땅을 증여한 사실이 나중에 알려졌어요.
examples.en: It later became known that my grandmother had given away her land.

examples.ko: 이번 증여 때문에 형제들 사이가 안 좋아졌어요.
examples.en: Because of this gift of property, relations between the siblings got worse.

explain: 살아 있을 때 대가 없이 재산을 주는 것이고, 죽은 뒤에 물려주는 '상속'과 달라요. 일상 대화에서는 '물려주다', '주다'라고 하고, '증여'는 세금이나 법 이야기에서 많이 나와요.

phrases.en: If you receive a house as a gift, you have to pay gift tax.
phrases.nuance_en: The tax paid by the person who receives a gift of property.

phrases.example: 사전 증여를 하면 나중에 상속세를 줄일 수 있어요.
phrases.en: If you give property in advance, you can reduce inheritance tax later.
phrases.nuance_ko: 죽기 전에 미리 재산을 주는 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means giving property in advance, before one's death.

phrases.en: I received a small apartment from my parents as a gift.
phrases.nuance_ko: 재산을 받는 사람의 입장에서 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The word used from the point of view of the person receiving the property.
phrases.en_equiv: to receive as a gift of property

explain_en: This means giving property without payment while the giver is alive, which differs from '상속' (inheritance after death). In daily talk people say '물려주다' or '주다', while '증여' appears mostly in talk about taxes and law.

examples.ko: 이사 가기 전에 안 쓰는 가구를 처분해요.
examples.en: Before moving, I get rid of the furniture I don't use.

examples.ko: 오래된 차를 처분하고 새 차를 샀어요.
examples.en: I got rid of the old car and bought a new one.

examples.ko: 집을 처분한 돈으로 가게를 열었어요.
examples.en: I opened a shop with the money from selling my house.

examples.ko: 쓰레기는 규칙대로 처분해야 해요.
examples.en: Trash must be disposed of according to the rules.

examples.ko: 재고를 싸게 처분할 계획이에요.
examples.en: We plan to sell off the stock cheaply.

examples.ko: 필요 없는 책은 한꺼번에 처분했어요.
examples.en: I got rid of the books I didn't need all at once.

explain: '팔다'는 돈을 받고 넘기는 것이고, '버리다'는 그냥 내놓는 것이에요. '처분하다'는 팔거나 버려서 정리한다는 넓은 말이라 집, 차, 재고처럼 큰 물건에 많이 써요.

phrases.en: I'm selling off my furniture cheaply because of the move.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빨리 없애려고 값을 낮춰서 팔 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you lower the price to get rid of something quickly.

phrases.en: I will sell my house next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 할 계획을 말할 때 쓰는 미래형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A future form for talking about a plan.

phrases.en: I cleared out the clothes I don't wear.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상에서는 작은 물건을 없앨 때 '정리하다'가 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: For small everyday items, 정리하다 sounds more natural.

explain_en: '팔다' means handing over for money and '버리다' means throwing away. '처분하다' covers both as 'getting rid of', and is often used for bigger things such as houses, cars or stock.

examples.ko: 회원에게는 여러 가지 특전이 있어요.
examples.en: Members get a variety of perks.

examples.ko: 예약하신 분들께 무료 음료 특전을 드려요.
examples.en: We give a free-drink perk to those who booked.

examples.ko: 이 영화는 특전으로 포스터를 나눠 줘요.
examples.en: This movie hands out posters as a special bonus.

examples.ko: 먼저 신청하면 특전을 받을 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you apply first, you can receive a special benefit.

examples.ko: 앨범을 사면 사진 특전이 같이 와요.
examples.en: If you buy the album, a photo bonus comes with it.

examples.ko: 오래 근무한 직원에게 특전을 줬어요.
examples.en: They gave a special benefit to employees who served long.

explain: 특전은 특정한 사람에게만 따로 주어지는 혜택이에요. 회원, 예약자, 팬에게 주는 선물이나 서비스를 말할 때 많이 써요. 누구에게나 주는 '혜택'보다 한정된 사람만 받는다는 느낌이 있어서 '특전' 안내문에 자주 나와요.

phrases.example: 회원은 여러 가지 특전을 받을 수 있어요.
phrases.en: Members can receive various special benefits.
phrases.nuance_ko: 혜택을 받는 사람 입장에서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the view of the person receiving the benefit.

phrases.en: We give a special benefit to those who made a reservation.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게나 회사가 손님에게 정중하게 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A polite way for a shop or company to speak to customers.

phrases.en: I got a discount coupon as a member perk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누구에게 주는 특전인지 앞에 붙여서 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the recipient group in front to say who gets it.

explain_en: 특전 is a benefit given only to certain people. It is used often for gifts or services for members, bookers, or fans. Compared with 혜택, which anyone may get, 특전 has a limited-recipient feel and often appears in promotional notices.
